article.title: V + 回 direccional simple
article.part: Modificación y complementos — 修飾與補語

claims.summary: The structure 'V + 回 (huí)' indicates that an action implies returning to a previous spatial location, position, or state.
Examples illustrate how '回' is used to denote returning to a previous location or state, such as '走回家' (walking back home) and '跑回教室' (running back to the classroom).
The note clarifies that '回' indicates return but does not specify whether the movement is approaching or moving away from the reference point, distinguishing it from '回來' and '回去'.
